+import AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.P1
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Projective.ProjectiveCoordinateChart
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Projective.RelativeProjectiveSpace

+/-!
+# Arbitrary standard charts of projective space
+
+For a finite coordinate type `J` and a distinguished coordinate `i : J`, this
+file identifies the degree-zero homogeneous localization at `X i` with the
+polynomial ring on the remaining coordinates.  This is the reindexed form of
+the standard `D_+(X_none)` chart calculation.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+open MvPolynomial HomogeneousLocalization
+
+noncomputable section
+
+universe u
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.AffineChartAtRing
+
+local instance (J R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
+    GradedRing (homogeneousSubmodule J R) :=
+  MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra
+
+variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
+variable (J : Type u)
+
+/-- Every homogeneous coordinate has degree one. -/
+theorem X_mem_deg_one (i : J) :
+    (X i : MvPolynomial J R) ∈ homogeneousSubmodule J R 1 :=
+  isHomogeneous_X _ _
+
+/-- The normalized coordinate `X_j / X_i` on `D_+(X_i)`. -/
+def chartCoord (i : J) (j : {j : J // j ≠ i}) :
+    Away (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X i) :=
+  Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X_mem_deg_one R J i) 1 (X j.1)
+    (by simpa using X_mem_deg_one R J j.1)
+
+/-- Dehomogenization at `X_i`: send `X_i` to one and the other variables to
+the corresponding variables of the complementary polynomial ring. -/
+def dehomogenize (i : J) :
+    MvPolynomial J R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} R := by
+  classical
+  exact MvPolynomial.aeval fun j ↦ if h : j = i then 1 else X ⟨j, h⟩
+
+@[simp]
+theorem dehomogenize_X_self (i : J) : dehomogenize R J i (X i) = 1 := by
+  classical
+  simp [dehomogenize]
+
+@[simp]
+theorem dehomogenize_X_ne (i : J) (j : {j : J // j ≠ i}) :
+    dehomogenize R J i (X j.1) = X j := by
+  classical
+  simp [dehomogenize, j.2]
+
+private theorem isUnit_dehomogenize_X_self (i : J) :
+    IsUnit ((dehomogenize R J i).toRingHom (X i)) := by
+  rw [show (dehomogenize R J i).toRingHom (X i) = 1 by
+    exact dehomogenize_X_self R J i]
+  exact isUnit_one
+
+/-- The polynomial algebra map generated by the normalized coordinates. -/
+def polyToAway (i : J) : MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} R →ₐ[R]
+    Away (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X i) :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval (chartCoord R J i)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem polyToAway_X (i : J) (j : {j : J // j ≠ i}) :
+    polyToAway R J i (X j) = chartCoord R J i j :=
+  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _
+
+/-- Dehomogenization descends to the degree-zero homogeneous localization. -/
+def awayToPoly (i : J) : Away (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X i) →ₐ[R]
+    MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} R where
+  toRingHom :=
+    (Localization.awayLift (dehomogenize R J i).toRingHom (X i)
+      (isUnit_dehomogenize_X_self R J i)).comp
+      (algebraMap (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X i))
+        (Localization.Away (X i : MvPolynomial J R)))
+  commutes' r := by
+    change (Localization.awayLift (dehomogenize R J i).toRingHom (X i)
+        (isUnit_dehomogenize_X_self R J i))
+        ((algebraMap R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X i)) r).val) =
+      algebraMap R (MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} R) r
+    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_val, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
+    exact (dehomogenize R J i).commutes r
+
+/-- Evaluation of dehomogenization on a homogeneous fraction. -/
+theorem awayToPoly_mk (i : J) (a : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial J R)
+    (hp : p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule J R (a • 1)) :
+    awayToPoly R J i
+        (Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X_mem_deg_one R J i) a p hp) =
+      dehomogenize R J i p := by
+  have h1 : (dehomogenize R J i).toRingHom (X i) * 1 = 1 := by
+    rw [mul_one]
+    exact dehomogenize_X_self R J i
+  have h := Localization.awayLift_mk
+    (A := MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} R)
+    (dehomogenize R J i).toRingHom (X i) p 1 h1 a
+  exact h.trans (by rw [one_pow, mul_one]; rfl)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem awayToPoly_chartCoord (i : J) (j : {j : J // j ≠ i}) :
+    awayToPoly R J i (chartCoord R J i j) = X j :=
+  (awayToPoly_mk R J i 1 (X j.1)
+    (by simpa using X_mem_deg_one R J j.1)).trans
+      (dehomogenize_X_ne R J i j)
+
+/-- Dehomogenization is a left inverse to the normalized-coordinate map. -/
+theorem awayToPoly_comp_polyToAway (i : J) :
+    (awayToPoly R J i).comp (polyToAway R J i) =
+      AlgHom.id R (MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} R) := by
+  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
+  intro j
+  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, polyToAway_X, awayToPoly_chartCoord, AlgHom.id_apply]
+
+/-! ### Surjectivity of the normalized-coordinate map -/
+
+/-- Every degree-zero homogeneous polynomial is a constant. -/
+theorem exists_algebraMap_eq_gradeZero
+    (c : homogeneousSubmodule J R 0) :
+    ∃ r : R, algebraMap R (homogeneousSubmodule J R 0) r = c := by
+  have hc : (c : MvPolynomial J R) ∈
+      (1 : Submodule R (MvPolynomial J R)) := by
+    rw [← homogeneousSubmodule_zero (σ := J) (R := R)]
+    exact c.2
+  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hc
+  exact ⟨r, Subtype.ext (by simpa using hr)⟩
+
+/-- The homogeneous coordinate ring is generated over its degree-zero part by
+its variables. -/
+theorem adjoin_gradeZero_range_X :
+    Algebra.adjoin (homogeneousSubmodule J R 0)
+      (Set.range (X : J → MvPolynomial J R)) = ⊤ := by
+  rw [eq_top_iff]
+  rintro p -
+  have hp : p ∈ Algebra.adjoin R
+      (Set.range (X : J → MvPolynomial J R)) := by
+    rw [MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X]
+    trivial
+  induction hp using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
+  | mem q hq => exact Algebra.subset_adjoin hq
+  | algebraMap r =>
+      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _
+        (⟨algebraMap R (MvPolynomial J R) r, by
+          rw [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
+          exact isHomogeneous_C _ r⟩ : homogeneousSubmodule J R 0)
+  | add q₁ q₂ _ _ h₁ h₂ => exact add_mem h₁ h₂
+  | mul q₁ q₂ _ _ h₁ h₂ => exact mul_mem h₁ h₂
+
+section Finite
+
+variable [Finite J]
+local instance : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
+local instance : DecidableEq J := Classical.decEq J
+
+/-- Split the total degree into the distinguished coordinate and all remaining
+coordinates. -/
+private theorem degree_eq (i : J) {e : J → ℕ} {a : ℕ}
+    (hae : ∑ l, e l • (1 : ℕ) = a • (1 : ℕ)) :
+    e i + ∑ j : {j : J // j ≠ i}, e j = a := by
+  rw [← (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_option] at hae
+  simpa using hae
+
+/-- A homogeneous monomial divided by the appropriate power of `X_i` is the
+corresponding monomial in the normalized coordinates. -/
+private theorem away_mk_prod_eq (i : J) (a : ℕ) (e : J → ℕ)
+    (hae : e i + ∑ j : {j : J // j ≠ i}, e j = a)
+    (H : (∏ l, (X l : MvPolynomial J R) ^ e l) ∈
+      homogeneousSubmodule J R (a • 1)) :
+    Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X_mem_deg_one R J i) a
+        (∏ l, X l ^ e l) H =
+      ∏ j : {j : J // j ≠ i}, chartCoord R J i j ^ e j := by
+  apply (show Function.Injective (algebraMap
+      (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X i))
+      (Localization.Away (X i : MvPolynomial J R))) from
+    HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _)
+  simp only [map_prod, map_pow, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
+    Away.val_mk, chartCoord, Localization.mk_pow, Localization.mk_prod]
+  rw [← (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i).prod_comp, Fintype.prod_option]
+  simp only [Equiv.optionSubtypeNe_none, Equiv.optionSubtypeNe_some]
+  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
+  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
+  push_cast
+  rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← hae, pow_add]
+  ring
+
+/-- Every element of the arbitrary standard chart ring is a polynomial in the
+normalized coordinates. -/
+theorem polyToAway_surjective (i : J) :
+    Function.Surjective (polyToAway R J i) := by
+  intro z
+  have hz : z ∈
+      (⊤ : Submodule (homogeneousSubmodule J R 0)
+        (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X i))) := trivial
+  rw [← Away.span_mk_prod_pow_eq_top (X_mem_deg_one R J i) X
+    (adjoin_gradeZero_range_X R J) (fun _ ↦ 1)
+    (fun l ↦ X_mem_deg_one R J l)] at hz
+  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
+  | mem w hw =>
+      obtain ⟨a, e, hae, rfl⟩ := hw
+      refine ⟨∏ j : {j : J // j ≠ i}, X j ^ e j, ?_⟩
+      rw [map_prod]
+      simp_rw [map_pow, polyToAway_X]
+      exact (away_mk_prod_eq R J i a e (degree_eq J i hae) _).symm
+  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
+  | add p q _ _ hp hq =>
+      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hp
+      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hq
+      exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩
+  | smul c p _ hp =>
+      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hp
+      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := exists_algebraMap_eq_gradeZero R J c
+      exact ⟨r • p, by rw [map_smul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]⟩
+
+omit [Finite J] in
+theorem awayToPoly_polyToAway_apply (i : J)
+    (p : MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} R) :
+    awayToPoly R J i (polyToAway R J i p) = p :=
+  AlgHom.congr_fun (awayToPoly_comp_polyToAway R J i) p
+
+/-- The normalized-coordinate map is a left inverse to dehomogenization. -/
+theorem polyToAway_comp_awayToPoly (i : J) :
+    (polyToAway R J i).comp (awayToPoly R J i) =
+      AlgHom.id R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X i)) := by
+  refine AlgHom.ext fun z ↦ ?_
+  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := polyToAway_surjective R J i z
+  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, awayToPoly_polyToAway_apply]
+
+/-- The `i`-th projective chart ring is the polynomial ring on all coordinates
+other than `i`. -/
+def awayAlgEquiv (i : J) :
+    Away (homogeneousSubmodule J R) (X i) ≃ₐ[R]
+      MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} R :=
+  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (awayToPoly R J i) (polyToAway R J i)
+    (awayToPoly_comp_polyToAway R J i) (polyToAway_comp_awayToPoly R J i)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem awayAlgEquiv_chartCoord (i : J) (j : {j : J // j ≠ i}) :
+    awayAlgEquiv R J i (chartCoord R J i j) = X j :=
+  awayToPoly_chartCoord R J i j
+
+@[simp]
+theorem awayAlgEquiv_symm_X (i : J) (j : {j : J // j ≠ i}) :
+    (awayAlgEquiv R J i).symm (X j) = chartCoord R J i j :=
+  (awayAlgEquiv R J i).symm_apply_eq.mpr
+    (awayAlgEquiv_chartCoord R J i j).symm
+
+omit [Finite J] in
+/-- The normalized coordinate used by the arbitrary chart calculation is the
+same element as the coordinate used by the projective-coordinate API. -/
+theorem chartCoord_eq_coordinates (i : J) (j : {j : J // j ≠ i}) :
+    chartCoord (ULift.{u} ℤ) J i j =
+      Coordinates.chartCoord i j.1 := by
+  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
+  rfl
+
+/-- Under the arbitrary chart equivalence, the existing normalized projective
+coordinate `X_j / X_i` is the corresponding affine variable. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem awayAlgEquiv_coordinates_chartCoord (i j : J) (hji : j ≠ i) :
+    awayAlgEquiv (ULift.{u} ℤ) J i (Coordinates.chartCoord i j) =
+      X (⟨j, hji⟩ : {j : J // j ≠ i}) := by
+  rw [← chartCoord_eq_coordinates J i ⟨j, hji⟩]
+  exact awayAlgEquiv_chartCoord (ULift.{u} ℤ) J i ⟨j, hji⟩
+
+/-- The inverse arbitrary chart equivalence sends an affine variable to the
+existing normalized projective coordinate. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem awayAlgEquiv_symm_X_eq_coordinates (i j : J) (hji : j ≠ i) :
+    (awayAlgEquiv (ULift.{u} ℤ) J i).symm
+        (X (⟨j, hji⟩ : {j : J // j ≠ i})) =
+      Coordinates.chartCoord i j := by
+  rw [awayAlgEquiv_symm_X, chartCoord_eq_coordinates]
+
+end Finite
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.AffineChartAtRing
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace
+
+variable (J : Type u) (i : J) (S : Scheme.{u})
+
+local notation3 "P[" J "]" =>
+  homogeneousSubmodule J (ULift ℤ)
+
+/-- The coordinate `X_i` has degree one in the integral homogeneous
+coordinate ring. -/
+private theorem X_i_mem_deg_one :
+    (X i : MvPolynomial J (ULift.{u} ℤ)) ∈ P[J] 1 :=
+  isHomogeneous_X _ _
+
+/-- The relative standard chart `D_+(X_i)` in projective space. -/
+def affineChartAt : Scheme.{u} :=
+  pullback (toProjInt J S)
+    (Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one)
+
+namespace affineChartAt
+
+/-- Inclusion of the arbitrary standard chart into relative projective
+space. -/
+def incl : affineChartAt J i S ⟶ ℙ(J; S) :=
+  pullback.fst (toProjInt J S)
+    (Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one)
+
+/-- Projection from the relative chart to the affine integral chart. -/
+def toSpecAway : affineChartAt J i S ⟶ Spec (.of (Away P[J] (X i))) :=
+  pullback.snd (toProjInt J S)
+    (Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one)
+
+instance : IsOpenImmersion (incl J i S) := by
+  dsimp [incl]
+  exact MorphismProperty.pullback_fst _ _
+    (Proj.instIsOpenImmersionAwayι P[J] (X i)
+      (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one)
+
+/-- The chart inclusion followed by the integral projection is the other
+pullback projection followed by the integral chart inclusion. -/
+@[reassoc]
+theorem incl_toProjInt :
+    incl J i S ≫ toProjInt J S =
+      pullback.snd (toProjInt J S)
+          (Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one) ≫
+        Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one :=
+  pullback.condition
+
+instance : (affineChartAt J i S).CanonicallyOver S where
+  hom := incl J i S ≫ (ℙ(J; S) ↘ S)
+
+@[simp]
+theorem over_eq : affineChartAt J i S ↘ S = incl J i S ≫ (ℙ(J; S) ↘ S) :=
+  rfl
+
+/-- The arbitrary chart is the inverse image of `D_+(X_i)` under the integral
+projection. -/
+theorem opensRange_incl :
+    (incl J i S).opensRange =
+      toProjInt J S ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen P[J] (X i) := by
+  change (pullback.fst (toProjInt J S)
+      (Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one)).opensRange = _
+  rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackFst, Proj.opensRange_awayι]
+
+section IsoAffineSpace
+
+variable [Finite J]
+
+/-- On integral models, the spectrum of the arbitrary chart ring is affine
+space on the complementary coordinates. -/
+def specAwayIso :
+    Spec (.of (Away P[J] (X i))) ≅
+      Spec (.of (MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} (ULift.{u} ℤ))) :=
+  (Scheme.Spec.mapIso
+    (((AffineChartAtRing.awayAlgEquiv (ULift.{u} ℤ) J i).toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso).op)).symm
+
+private def integralChartIncl :
+    Spec (.of (Away P[J] (X i))) ⟶ Proj P[J] :=
+  Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one
+
+private def flattenIso :
+    affineChartAt J i S ≅
+      pullback (terminal.from S)
+        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) :=
+  pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso
+    (terminal.from S) (terminal.from (Proj P[J])) (integralChartIncl J i)
+
+private def changeChartHom :
+    pullback (terminal.from S)
+        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) ⟶
+      𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) :=
+  pullback.map
+    (terminal.from S)
+    (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J]))
+    (terminal.from S)
+    (terminal.from
+      (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} (ULift.{u} ℤ)))))
+    (𝟙 S) (specAwayIso J i).hom (𝟙 (⊤_ Scheme)) (by simp) (by simp)
+
+private instance : IsIso (changeChartHom J i S) := by
+  dsimp [changeChartHom]
+  apply pullback.map_isIso
+
+@[reassoc]
+private theorem changeChartHom_over :
+    changeChartHom J i S ≫ (𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) ↘ S) =
+      pullback.fst (terminal.from S)
+        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) := by
+  change pullback.lift _ _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = _
+  rw [pullback.lift_fst, Category.comp_id]
+
+omit [Finite J] in
+@[reassoc]
+private theorem flattenIso_hom_over :
+    (flattenIso J i S).hom ≫
+        pullback.fst (terminal.from S)
+          (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) =
+      pullback.fst (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt J S) (integralChartIncl J i) ≫
+        (ℙ(J; S) ↘ S) :=
+  pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_fst _ _ _
+
+/-- The relative standard chart `D_+(X_i)` is affine space on all coordinates
+other than `i`. -/
+def isoAffineSpace :
+    affineChartAt J i S ≅ 𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) :=
+  flattenIso J i S ≪≫ asIso (changeChartHom J i S)
+
+@[reassoc]
+theorem isoAffineSpace_hom_over :
+    (isoAffineSpace J i S).hom ≫ (𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) ↘ S) =
+      affineChartAt J i S ↘ S := by
+  change ((flattenIso J i S ≪≫ asIso (changeChartHom J i S)).hom) ≫
+      (𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) ↘ S) = affineChartAt J i S ↘ S
+  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, asIso_hom, changeChartHom_over,
+    flattenIso_hom_over]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Under the affine-space identification, the integral polynomial-space
+projection is the chart projection followed by the chart-ring equivalence. -/
+@[reassoc]
+theorem isoAffineSpace_hom_toSpecMvPoly :
+    (isoAffineSpace J i S).hom ≫
+        AffineSpace.toSpecMvPoly {j : J // j ≠ i} S =
+      toSpecAway J i S ≫ (specAwayIso J i).hom := by
+  change ((flattenIso J i S).hom ≫ changeChartHom J i S) ≫
+      pullback.snd _ _ = _
+  rw [Category.assoc]
+  change (flattenIso J i S).hom ≫
+      (pullback.lift _ _ _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _) = _
+  rw [pullback.lift_snd]
+  change (flattenIso J i S).hom ≫
+      pullback.snd (terminal.from S)
+        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) ≫
+        (specAwayIso J i).hom =
+    pullback.snd (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt J S) (integralChartIncl J i) ≫
+      (specAwayIso J i).hom
+  exact pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd_assoc _ _ _ _
+
+end IsoAffineSpace
+
+end affineChartAt
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace
